name: @fluentui/react-tailwind-theme
description: Shared Tailwind v4 theme layer for the CSS Modules styling migration: cascade layer order, custom variants, the base-scale spacing bridge, and the generated Fluent token registration (css/tokens.css). Fluent tokens stay runtime CSS custom properties written by FluentProvider; `@theme inline` only gives them utility names, so utilities compile to direct var(--token) references and per-provider theming is unchanged. Spacing is the one exception: the 22 spacing tokens and the 4 strokeWidth tokens register under --spacing-* as base-scale VALUES, so the named (p-horizontal-m, w-thin) and numeric (p-12) scales are one system. The 4 stroke widths are additionally emitted as real --spacing-thin/thick/thicker/thickest custom properties, because border/outline/ring/decoration widths do not consume the spacing namespace and must be authored as a direct var().
